Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding annual backflow preventer inspections and tests.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting purveyors from performing orcontracting for the performance of annual backflow preventerinspections and tests; and adding a new section to chapter 70.119A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.119ARCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Purveyors may not, either directly or through contractedservices, conduct annual backflow preventer inspections and testsrequired by rules adopted under RCW 43.20.050. (2) Purveyors shall develop and maintain a list of local persons orfirms who are qualified to conduct annual backflow preventerinspections and tests. Lists required by this subsection must bedistributed, either by mail or through a web site or other electronicmeans, to purveyor customers who are required by rules adopted underRCW 43.20.050 to have annual backflow preventer inspections and tests.
